title: 6 Barrett Place - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents..."6 Barrett Place," a one-of-a-kind Rosemary Beach condo with an unbelievable rooftop terrace! Located in the heart of Barrett Square, it boasts a HUGE private balcony for sunrise coffee and sunset cocktails, a gourmet Viking kitchen, covered garage parking, elevator, and proximity to pools, shops, and the white sand beach. Includes 4 bikes to explore! Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Spectacular rooftop terrace with 3 living spaces for dining, lounging, and relaxingSpacious accommodations: Primary King Suite, Guest Queen, and Room with 2 TwinsCentral location in the heart of Barrett Square near shops, restaurants, and white sand beachesEnjoy exclusive access to Rosemary Beach’s 4 Private Community Pools, World Class Tennis Courts, and a fully equipped Fitness CenterChef’s kitchen with Viking appliances and marble countertops4 included bikes for effortless coastal cruisingCovered garage parking with private parking spotSecured access for elevator and building*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step into a one-of-a-kind experience with your own private rooftop terrace—the largest outdoor condo space in all of Rosemary Beach, whether beachside or park side! This stunning open-air retreat draws you in from the moment you step through the open concept living and dining area, offering an unbeatable space for entertaining or relaxing.Three unique living spaces: a dining area with seating, a sectional sofa lounge, and chaise lounges for ultimate comfortAmbiance at every turn: soothing fountains, lush palm trees, and ambient lighting to create the perfect mood day or nightUnparalleled views: enjoy both majestic sunrises in the east and serene sunsets in the west, all from the privacy of your terraceFully equipped for entertaining: includes even an ice maker and thoughtfully designed layout to host gatherings with easeBy day, sip cocktails as the sun lights up the terrace. By night, bask under the stars with beautifully placed lighting to set the scene. This rooftop oasis is truly a dream come to life!*** LIVING AREAS ***Enter this chic, professionally designed space and be greeted by abundant natural light and an open concept layout perfect for entertaining. The living room features ample seating with a unique sectional, side chairs, and a large flat-screen TV for unwinding after a day at the beach.Open concept living and dining area with rooftop accessLarge flat-screen TV and comfortable seatingRelaxed, beachy decor with elegant touches*** KITCHEN & DINING ***You'll love crafting meals in this chef-inspired kitchen, complete with Viking appliances, marble countertops, a large kitchen island, and a stylish breakfast bar with seating for 4. Enjoy your meals at the sophisticated dining table that accommodates 6 guests.Stainless steel Viking appliancesLarge kitchen island for cooking and entertainingBreakfast bar seating for 4Spacious dining area with seating for 6*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary Suite: Luxurious king-size bed, French doors to the terrace, and a spa-like en-suite bath with rain shower, jets, and handheld Grohe fixtures.Queen Bedroom: Cozy queen-size bed, French door access to the terrace, and stylish shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo.Twin Bedroom: 2 twin beds with charming barn-style entry door, flat-screen TV, and shared bath access.*** ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY ***Perfectly situated in Barrett Square, everything you need is within a short walk. Enjoy casual and fine dining, boutique shopping, and scenic pathways. The renowned Rosemary Beach white sand beach is just a stone's throw away. Plus, access to 4 pristine community pools ensures that relaxation is always within reach.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during checkout or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 203876
